title: Anthropic Spends $1 Billion to Secure Computing Power: Partnering with Startup Volta, Norway Data Center Becomes a New Pivot

content_html:
Anthropic has thrown another heavy punch to feed the growing demand for its Claude. According to insiders, the developer of Claude has signed a six-year, $1 billion computing power agreement with Volta Infra Holdings Ltd., a newly established infrastructure startup, which is the latest step it has taken to meet product demands.

Volta itself is no ordinary company - this cloud infrastructure startup backed by NVIDIA recently announced a $1 billion collaboration with an unnamed AI lab, and it now appears to be Anthropic. More intriguing is the way it is being implemented: Volta will team up with Bitdeer Technologies Group, a Bitcoin mining company that operates data centers, to deploy computing power in facilities located in Norway. In other words, Anthropic is looking to the idle mining capacity in Northern Europe, binding the young infrastructure provider's capacity directly to the cause of Claude through a six-year contract.

content_html_zh:
Anthropic 又重拳出击，以满足对其 Claude 日益增长的需求。 据内部人士透露，Claude的开发商已与新成立的基础设施初创公司Volta Infra Holdings Ltd.签署了一份为期六年、价值10亿美元的算力协议，这是其为满足产品需求而采取的最新举措。

Volta 本身并不是一家普通的公司——这家由 NVIDIA 支持的云基础设施初创公司最近宣布与一家未透露姓名的 AI 实验室进行 10 亿美元的合作，现在看来是 Anthropic。 更有趣的是它的实施方式：Volta 将与运营数据中心的比特币挖矿公司 Bitdeer Technologies Group 合作，在位于挪威的设施中部署计算能力。 换句话说，Anthropic正在寻找北欧闲置的挖矿能力，通过一份为期六年的合同将这家年轻的基础设施提供商的能力直接与克劳德的事业绑定在一起。
